sloka: त्वया तस्य निरस्तस्य पीडितस्य विशेषतः ।इह एत्य पुनर् आह्वानम् शंकाम् जनयति इव मे ॥४-१५-११॥
transliteration: tvayā tasya nirastasya pīḍitasya viśeṣataḥ ।iha etya punar āhvānam śaṁkām janayati iva me ॥4-15-11॥

translations.english: 'One who is defeated and badly mauled by you is again coming and inviting you to a duel in this manner arouses suspicion in me.
